features: explicit one opponent re-raise with our fold/call response
selection: Highest equally weighted real/stress chip result between combined_light and combined_full; single features are diagnostic only. All three features remain enabled in released experiment.

confirmation.primary_field: 19 development opponents, equally weighted real/stress; held-out strategies only for regression checks

promotion: Require positive 95% seed-block t intervals for balanced chip and point gain; nonnegative real-field and stress-field mean; no materially negative opponent change (upper per-opponent interval < -0.25 bb/deal), and no clear direct loss to jish_4 or jish_8. If not met retain default jish_4; push experiment regardless.
limitations: Known opponents; fresh deals rather than unseen opponents. Per-opponent intervals exploratory and unadjusted.
